proposal.inferred_root_cause: PSP degradation on the card path for card:icici at 32% success over 96 attempts
proposal.reasoning_trace: card:icici has dropped to 32% success over 96 attempts against a 90% portfolio baseline, and the only open notice names card:kkbk, a different issuer on the same method. Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. The open notice on card:kkbk is a different issuer and explains nothing here. Attempt 2 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on card after 8m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear.
